desc: Prove/record the component characterization and the identity components = |S| - adjacent_present_pairs for any subarray.

Implement O(N) sweep-line maintaining last[v], sum_last, and adjacent_min_sum; update only adjacent pairs involving the current value and accumulate answer = sum_last - adjacent_min_sum for each right endpoint.
Handle edge cases: N=1, values 1 and N, absent values, duplicate occurrences, and large 64-bit/Python-int answer.
Run sample tests and random brute-force checks for small N to verify f computation and summation; ensure O(N) time/memory.
